World Elephant Day Celebrated Across India

Multiple Indian news outlets reported on celebrations for World Elephant Day. In Hyderabad, elephants at the zoo participated in a 5-kilometer walk. North Bengal's Jaldapara National Park also held events, including a 'birthday' celebration for elephants. The coverage highlighted the lives of elephants in India.
